claim: On GPT-2 small RAG with three simultaneous changes (stale index, prompt-template edit, inert log setting), one-factor interventions with 30 runs per cell attributed the known real fault for 4/4 affected questions, never blamed the zero-effect index (4/4 unaffected questions) or the inert setting (0/8), and the model's scores were deterministic on re-scoring.
integrity_note: Integrity is not truth: a verifying manifest shows these files are unchanged since packaging; it does not show the experiment or the claim is correct.
scope: Pre-registered (protocol 47ce955). Two-option sampling from GPT-2's own probabilities on Experiment 1's 8 fictional questions. The fault attribution was close to mechanical. Small real template effects (true TVD 0.05-0.11 on q3, q7) were not detected at 30 runs per cell. Factors were chosen and switched by the author, so this is not a blind test. Traces are regenerable and not included. Single author.
